class.name: JRPGShowChoicesCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: lets the player pick one of up to six choices, and runs its branch.
class.description: Asks the player to pick one of [member choices] through the presentation port (a [code]"choices"[/code] request, see [JRPGLocalPort]); blank choices are not shown. The commands of the choice picked then run ([method get_branch]), and the event goes on after this command. Pressing cancel is refused, runs [member cancel_branch], or picks a choice, as [member cancel] says. Without an answer (nothing presents the request), what cancel does happens, or the default choice is taken when cancel is refused. An answer that is not one of the choices runs no branch, with a warning. Authority: both (it presents, and the branch taken changes what the event does).

method.name: get_branch
method.description: Returns the commands that run when choice [param choice] (0 to 5) is picked.

method.name: set_branch
method.description: Sets the commands that run when choice [param choice] (0 to 5) is picked.

members.member: The commands of the first choice.
The commands of the second choice.
The commands of the third choice.
The commands of the fourth choice.
The commands of the fifth choice.
The commands of the sixth choice.
What cancel does: [constant CANCEL_DISALLOWED], [constant CANCEL_BRANCH], or the index of the choice it picks (0 to 5).
The commands that run when cancel is pressed and [member cancel] is [constant CANCEL_BRANCH].
The choices' texts, with control codes; up to [constant MAX_CHOICES]. A blank choice is not shown.
The choice the cursor starts on (0 to 5), or [code]-1[/code] for none.
Where the choice window shows beside the message window: left, middle or right.
The key the choices are translated through: choice [i]n[/i] through [code]"<text_key>.<n>"[/code], counting from 1.
